content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Calicut Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 12-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut) for an ISRO sponsored project under the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on a contract basis under the Department of Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position in this recruitment notification released by NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech or M.Tech degree in relevant Engineering streams or a Post Graduate Degree (MSc/MCA) along with being GATE or NET qualified.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit to apply for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut is set at 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary or stipend offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus 18% HRA as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the duly filled application form along with required documents via email is 12-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for NIT Calicut Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly through email. Candidates must send their consolidated single PDF applications to the designated institutional email addresses.

faq.question: Q9. When is the selection interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The selection interview for the shortlisted candidates who applied for the Junior Research Fellow position is scheduled to be held on 16-10-2026 in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for this research fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting based on essential qualification criteria followed by a selection interview conducted in hybrid mode.
